pages.title: 5 checks before you post a product photo
pages.lead: Run these on every listing photo, especially photos you edited or made with AI.

steps.title: Keep one unedited photo
steps.text: Most Etsy listings now need one unedited photo of the actual item on a real background. Keep the original from your camera roll.

steps.title: Say so if AI made or edited it
steps.text: Many AI tools write a marker into the file that platforms read. Etsy expects AI use in the listing description; Instagram and Facebook may label it.

steps.title: Remove a saved location
steps.text: Phone photos can store where they were taken, and anyone who downloads the original file can read it. Remove it before you share originals.

steps.title: Check what else the file says
steps.text: The camera, the date and the editing app can stay in the file. Make sure nothing there contradicts what your listing says.

steps.title: Show the real item
steps.text: Color, size, condition and flaws should match what the buyer receives. If the item is materially different, you may have to refund.

callout.label: KEEP THE ORIGINALS
callout.text: Chat apps, social media and many design tools save images without their data. Keep the original files and the date you took them, in case a listing is questioned.

pages.title: Check a photo in 30 seconds
pages.lead: CheckMaybe Photo Check reads the file in your browser. Your photo is never uploaded. checkmaybe-photo-check.pages.dev

steps.title: Open Photo Check
steps.text: On a computer or phone: checkmaybe-photo-check.pages.dev

steps.title: Choose the original file
steps.text: Pick it from your camera roll or folder, not a copy sent through a chat app or saved from social media.

steps.title: Read the verdict
steps.text: See the camera data, editing apps, AI markers, Content Credentials and saved location the file still carries.

steps.title: Do the to-do list
steps.text: Under “Still for you to check”: what to disclose, what to remove and which photo can be your unedited one.

callout.label: WHAT IT CAN’T PROVE
callout.text: Missing AI markers don’t prove an image isn’t AI-made, and camera data doesn’t prove a photo was never edited. Platforms also use their own detection.
